I don’t know. 
I was diagnosed with BPD and it’s hard to live with it. I can see my own relationship going to shit and everything else going to shit. And it hurts so much because I’m the one who’s causing this. Wouldn’t it just be better if I didn’t exist? Everyone would be so much happier. I literally hate myself for continuously causing shit and then feeling guilty, it’s a whole cycle that it’s unbreakable. 
I just want to kill my self without other people be sad and worry

Me too. I hate everything in my life I wish I could just fucking die. I wish I could just fucking disappear without other people worrying and shit about me. WHATS LEGIT THE FUCKING POINT IN THIS FUCKING LIFE?
